root: one bounded shared neutral palm placement per hand optimized over all home fingers; constant across excerpt, never per-note teleport
finger_DOF: 3 bounded palmar flexions plus base spread; no axial twist; no negative flexion

phases_seconds.NEXT_NOTE_TRANSITION: return to home hover through same release curve

key_audio_clock: same absolute timeline; NOTE_ON is first contact and key-down start; key reaches full travel 35ms later
optimizer: one global home placement solve per hand (max200 evaluations), then one deterministic sequential local joint solve per finger and120Hz observation (max35 evaluations); no random restarts or tuning sweeps
